Class StandardCommands

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.StandardCommands
@ViewScoped public class StandardCommands extends Object
The standard commands of a view, with working handlers, and the superclass of every generated <Class>Commands. Injectable on its own by views that declare no command. Every instance in a view returns the same BoundCommand for a standard command, or the command that the view class overrides it with.

Their text and shortcuts come from the framework's resources, per platform and locale; an application overrides them in its own TOML ([commands.exit]).
